pair.title: Connect to a Dahlia server
pair.intro: The app looks for Dahlia servers in the network. You can also type the address.
pair.none_found: No server found. Type the address below.
pair.check_where: Compare it with the fingerprint on the server's monitor or in the dashboard under Addresses. Connect only if both match.
pair.trust_hint: The operating system will ask whether to trust the certificate.
error.not_dahlia: No Dahlia server at this address.
error.trust: The certificate could not be added.
pair.code_hint: Open the dashboard in a browser, for example from the bookmark on the phone, tap the phone icon at the top and create a pairing code.
error.changed: The server answers with another certificate, for example after a reinstall. Pair again, easiest with a pairing code from the dashboard on the phone.
error.code: No valid pairing code. Create a new one in the dashboard.
error.proof: The code does not match this server. Do not connect if you do not know this address.
